Priya: Heads-up — final on-site round tomorrow 11:00am PT for candidate A. Can the panel confirm roles and debrief owner? Also need recording permission and a quiet room for the live coding slot. :wave:
Samir: I can cover system design and be debrief owner.
Jordan: I'll do behavioral + hiring rubric scoring. Where's the rubric link?
Priya: Rubric here: https://redwood.company/hiring/rubrics/final-engineer — please use the "5-point" scale. Scoring focus: problem decomposition, tradeoffs, and communication.
Maya: Room booked: Conf Room B (zoom link in calendar). 15m buffer before/after. Also asking: should we record? need candidate consent.
Jordan: @Priya I'll DM candidate to confirm recording consent. Any recommended phrasing?
Priya: Suggested message: "Quick note — we record debriefs for hiring calibration only. Do you consent to the session being recorded?" Keep it short.
InterviewBot: Reminder scheduled: send interviewer pre-brief 30m before start (auto).
Samir: Quick ask — can someone drop the starter kit in #interview-kit? I want the prompt and time-box.
Maya: Dropped starter kit in the calendar invite and pasted below for convenience:
```
Coding exercise: implement async rate limiter (30m)
Rubric highlights: correctness, tests, clarity of tradeoffs
Time: 30m coding + 20m debrief
```
Jordan: Also flag: please use the structured debrief form after — link: https://redwood.company/hiring/debrief-form. Fill scores before leaving.
Priya: Thanks all. If anyone needs to swap last-minute, call out here asap. :thumbsup:
